import triton
import triton.language as tl


@triton.jit
def _layer_norm_forward_kernel(
    Y_ptr,
    Y_row_stride,
    X_ptr,
    X_row_stride,
    W_ptr,
    W_row_stride,
    B_ptr,
    B_row_stride,
    Mean_ptr,
    Mean_row_stride,
    RSTD_ptr,
    RSTD_row_stride,
    n_cols,
    eps,
    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
):
    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)

    cols = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
    w_ptrs = W_ptr + cols
    b_ptrs = B_ptr + cols
    x_row_ptr = X_ptr + row * X_row_stride
    x_ptrs = x_row_ptr + cols

    col_mask = cols < n_cols

    b = tl.load(b_ptrs, mask=col_mask, other=0.0)
    x = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=col_mask, other=0.0)
    w = tl.load(w_ptrs, mask=col_mask, other=0.0)

    mean = tl.sum(x, axis=0) / n_cols

    mean_ptr = Mean_ptr + row * Mean_row_stride
    tl.store(mean_ptr, mean)

    centered = x - mean
    squared = centered * centered
    variance = tl.sum(squared, axis=0) / n_cols
    variance_eps = variance + eps
    std = tl.sqrt(variance_eps)
    rstd = 1.0 / std

    rstd_ptr = RSTD_ptr + row * RSTD_row_stride
    tl.store(rstd_ptr, rstd)

    normalized = centered * rstd
    weighted = normalized * w
    y = weighted + b

    y_row_ptr = Y_ptr + row * Y_row_stride
    y_ptrs = y_row_ptr + cols
    tl.store(y_ptrs, y, mask=col_mask)
